description: This file defines a RecyclerView.Adapter named NavigationAdapter used to display a list of navigation items in an Android app, including handling item click events and customizing item appearance.

classes.name: NavigationAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class for displaying navigation items in a RecyclerView, managing item list, selection, and branding.

methods.name: NavigationAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing context, branding color, and click listener.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Updates the adapter's color based on brand customization and refreshes the list.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and inflates a new NavigationViewHolder for a list item.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder for a specific position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of navigation items.

methods.name: setItems
methods.description: Sets the list of navigation items, ensuring default values for uncategorized items.

methods.name: setSelectedItem
methods.description: Marks an item as selected by its ID and refreshes the list.
